race.comment: VENOM WOLF (5) closed off strongly last start to get up for third, beaten a neck, over 1612m at this track. Should be winding up late again. FLASH PRINCE (11) turned in an eye-catching run over 1900m at Kempsey last time, ridden back before coming home with a powerful run to finish third. Watch for another barnstorming finish. HOTZINO (9) has been in the placings at her last two starts, finishing second last time over 1450m at Kempsey after she got a long way back in the run. Taking on a better field but she is up to the task. SEETHING CHUCK (12) ran a better race last start to finish a close second over a similar trip at Taree after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Nicely placed to maintain the form. SECRET KEEPER (8) caught the eye with a strong finishing effort here last time in a blanket finish.
